description: Municipal Council Office - Kurunegala. Sri Dalada Poson Perahera at the Athkanda Rajamaha Viharaya in Kurunegala-Perahara Pageant route.
reasoning: This gazette notification announces temporary traffic restrictions and alternative routes for a religious procession (Sri Dalada Poson Perahera) in Kurunegala, issued under the Municipal Council's "By-law on Halting and Handling of Vehicles" and the Municipal Council Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory measure governing public traffic and road usage during a specific event, falling under Legal/Regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure, land, commercial, elections, public service, judicial, or miscellaneous categories.
